race.description: Great Northern Brewing Co Qtis Mdn Hcp
race.comment: The maidens kick us off. Former Victorian PRAGUE PRIDE (7) was well supported when having her first run for the new stable but didn't measure up on that occasion. Will have taken a lot of benefit with that run now under the belt and where there's smoke there's fire. Should find this easier than what she faced down south and watch for sharp improvement. DARK FAE (3) is a former NSW galloper who has hit the top-four in all three runs since moving north. Has to be included in calculations. OKAY ZOOMER (6) is unlucky to still be a maiden finishing runner-up at the past couple. In the mix. OVERLAND (4) gets Wiggins in the stirrups and can make his presence felt. STYLISH ROSIE (8) next best.
